summary: Keep sealed replication status comparisons on one database read cut.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection rebuild is added.

schema.detail: No table, column, index or trigger changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint, signature and inventory digest rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: A sealed status read now evaluates pending input and its inventory from the same SQLite cut. An older pinned reader keeps pending comparison while a newer writer seals and publishes a snapshot, avoiding a false report of certified projection drift. The peer wire format is unchanged.

recovery.detail: No new persistent state or recovery procedure is introduced.
